+import re
+from pathlib import Path
+import typer
+import subprocess
+import sys
+
+app = typer.Typer()
+
+@app.command()
+def main(version: str):
+    """
+    Automate release preparation: bump version and update release notes.
+    """
+    # Bump version in fastapi/__init__.py
+    init_file = Path("fastapi/__init__.py")
+    content = init_file.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
+    new_content = re.sub(r'__version__ = ".*"', f'__version__ = "{version}"', content)
+    init_file.write_text(new_content, encoding="utf-8")
+    typer.echo(f"Bumped version to {version} in {init_file}")
+
+    # Add version header to release-notes.md
+    release_notes_file = Path("docs/en/docs/release-notes.md")
+    content = release_notes_file.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
+    
+    # Find the first version header
+    match = re.search(r"^## \d+\.\d+\.\d+", content, re.MULTILINE)
+    if match:
+        start = match.start()
+        if f"## {version}" not in content:
+            new_content = content[:start] + f"## {version}\n\n" + content[start:]
+            release_notes_file.write_text(new_content, encoding="utf-8")
+            typer.echo(f"Added version {version} to {release_notes_file}")
+        else:
+            typer.echo(f"Version {version} already exists in {release_notes_file}")
+    else:
+        typer.echo(f"Could not find any version header in {release_notes_file}")
+
+    # Add date to release notes
+    subprocess.run([sys.executable, "scripts/add_latest_release_date.py"], check=True)
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    app()
